summary: Catalyst Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $200 million gross proceeds. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and a right to receive one-seventh of a share upon a future business combination. The company also granted underwriters a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 3 million additional units. Standard IPO-related agreements were entered into, including underwriting, share rights, trust, and registration rights agreements. This is a routine SPAC IPO current report, not a special-situation event; no business combination or other transformative transaction is disclosed.
